verdict.rationale: ZCode is documented as an AI coding workbench with a terminal agent and multi-agent collaboration. Its 'Goal' feature plans, executes and verifies multi-step work, and users report it 'works pretty well' and that the GLM model seems capable, which implies general agentic code tasks. However, nothing in the evidence specifically shows test writing, lint fixing, merge-conflict resolution or dependency updates. missing for 10: explicit evidence of test generation, lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, dependency updating, and hands-on corroboration of any of these.
